# Public description snapshots

Retrieved October 6, 2026 for deterministic import tests:

- `biocode-datacite.json`: [DataCite metadata](https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.60950/7efde9b6-eddf-4011-83ac-885605d05bc9).
- `biocode-schemaorg.json`: embedded JSON-LD from [Biocode 2.0 Project](https://iplacesalliance.org/gumpstation/articles/7/index.html), by Neil Davies, Adrienne Correa, Christopher Meyer, and Rebecca Vega Thurber, iPlaces Gump. The source page identifies its content license as [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

These are source metadata, not live GEOME or iPlaces configuration exports. Original fields are retained; pretty-printing and extracting the JSON-LD script are the only fixture transformations. Tests do not require these services to be online.
